content.subject: Quick thought on fulfillment partnerships
content.draft_text:
Hi AJ,

I saw your comment about steering clear of the cheapest 3PL and treating the partner as a long‑term investment. That perspective resonates with the challenges many growing stores face.

Fulfillment data arrives in formats that require manual cross‑checking, which can slow order processing. When mismatches slip through, customer satisfaction can dip.

We automate the reconciliation of fulfillment and payment records, eliminating manual entry.

Is manual reconciliation a friction point you’re watching?

Zamp
